profile.headline: Software Engineer & System Geek - Back-End Development: C# .Net, Cloud, Kubernetes, Strategic Roadmaps
profile.summary: I am a back-end software engineer always looking for the next challenge. With over a decade of experience in the software industry, I bring a breadth of knowledge from multiple domains and roles. I enjoy learning new technologies and concepts and taking on difficult problems. I am passionate about cloud technologies, system design, security, and identifying and solving the right problem.  Interested in partnering with mission-driven and inclusive organizations who are looking for a creative and highly technical problem solver.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Formalized Cloud Strategy team, creating mission, scope, values, vision, and a roadmap. Pioneered adopting quarterly OKRs in Engineering. 
• Implemented Tech Radar Initiative to convey technical direction, the current technological landscape, and to share insights.
• Researched future Azure networking egress costs and implemented a new AKS cluster to save a 40k/month cost increase.  
• Lead Cybersecurity Maturity Model adoption process to meet compliance requirements, selecting the models, mapping to compliance requirements, and creating a phased, cross-team adoption plan.
• Planned and proposed a Security Champions Program to kickstart the company's application security program.
• Spearheaded vendor evaluation for DevSecOps tooling and selected a tool that would yield  ~ 1 million ROI in the first year of adoption and greater than 2M the following year.
• Actively run, operate, and maintain 12 AKS Clusters across 6 datacenter regions with 100s of nodes, and thousands of cores, supporting services from every engineering team. Our clusters represent some of Microsoft's largest production Windows AKS Clusters and we've actively partnered with Microsoft's .NET and AKS teams to help them improve the Windows on AKS experience.
• Created cross-platform observability dashboards to give insight into system metrics for AKS hosted applications using Prometheus, Grafana, and Loki.
•  Designed and implemented a permissions and access management model for all cloud resources. Moved all engineering Azure permissions to Terraform and created a change management process to improve consistency, governance, disaster recovery, and transparency.
• Made network improvements including updating Azure Firewall WAF policies, Azure FrontDoor, and revamping company VPN, VWAN Hubs and firewalls.
• Addressed security vulnerabilities, including implementing engineering-wide networking rules and policies, monitoring and patching VMS, running dependency audits, and setting up security tooling.

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
• Investigated, trialed, and selected an infrastructure-as-code toolset and platform. Spearheaded adoption of IAC across the organization, integrating with pipelines, and standardizing practices, state storage, and recovery practices, as well as detailing IAC hierarchy, infrastructure ownership, and workflows. 
• Worked with a small team to stand up company's first Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) Clusters. Clusters supported both Windows and Linux workloads, had all components controlled via terraform, and utilized Azure Active Directory, and resource pooling. 
• Onboarded the first Linux API workload onto Kubernetes, cutting hosting costs and enabling scale, and  then onboarded the first windows workload running a large scale (over 3k cores). 
• Lead adoption of a new suite of technologies including Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, and Terraform. Partnered with all engineering teams to train and mentor engineers in the adoption of new hosting, deployment, infrastructure, and security best practices and onboard every product onto AKS clusters.  
•  Designed a new development environment model to simplify the SDLC flow, shorten cycle time, and pave the way for dynamic environments.
• Conducted and organized diversity and inclusion discussions across engineering which lead to the formation of an official company sponsored Diversity and Inclusion Committee. Participated in recruiting events and suggested improvements to the hiring process to improve the diversity of the candidate pool.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•  Enabled MFA for SkyKick products login and moved Authentication configuration and setup into source control and created pipelines to standardize updates and changes.
• Conducted deep-dive design review on company's current authentication methods and flows and capabilities and created a detailed IAM roadmap for improvements. 
•  Implemented .Net framework update and SDK style package reference change on a monolithic application with over 100 projects. Improved developer experience, resolved binding redirect issues, and identified and deleted over 300 unused projects in the solution. Presented key takeaways from the project to the rest of engineering.
• Selected for high profile virtual team to update the SkyKick engineering platform and participated in strategic Microsoft Technology Center meetings with CTO and Architects to help set the future technological direction of the company.
• Redesigned engineering's Azure Subscription organization and resource hierarchy, to improve security, governance, and standardization with review and buy-in from CTO, architects, directors, and Microsoft architects.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
FRAMEWORKS AND LIBRARIES
• Designed and implemented libraries and internal frameworks for deserialization, logging,
validation, authentication, exception handling, internal function to function calls, and
response standardization

• Advocated for and solved how to accomplish dependency injection in a nascent server-less
framework which did not support it out of the box

• Mentored and coached new hires and junior developers in best practices, design concepts,
and coding standards.

• Selected and set up xUnit/Moq for unit tests, postman tests for integration tests, and assisted
in integrating tests into the deployment pipeline

AUTHENTICATION
• Integrated with Auth0 to set up OAuth2.0 authentication with OIDC, enabling Implicit,
Password, and Client Credential grant types

• Designed sign-up and invite flows that support profile linking and multi-tenancy

• Wrote an authentication interface that validates access tokens and claim information, and a
client to interact with the authenticating server’s APIs

• Created webhooks and scripts to customize claims information and link sign up to profile
creation across multiple datastores

SERVICES
• Wrote user profile, product, and product component services with C# Azure Functions

• Designed REST API, standardized endpoints, and assisted in model and datastore design

• Proposed and implemented business logic layer and interface designs to minimize untestable
code and allow for code reuse

• Lead transition to use DAO/DTOs to improve client experience and introduce a layer of
abstraction between data model and endpoints
positions.insights: Skills: RESTful WebServices · Microservices · .NET Framework · SDLC · Cosmos Db · Azure · Azure DevOps · .NET Core · Cloud-Native Architecture · OAuth · Identity & Access Management (IAM) · C# · Authentication · Agile Methodologies · Azure Functions · Software Development · Cloud Computing · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD)

positions.title: Creator/ Software Engineer for Recipe Web App
positions.description:
Developed product concept, specifications, and design for ReciTree, a source-control and
social connectivity application for recipes

Created a loosely-coupled C# RESTful service in ASP.NetCore with endpoints for recipe,
recipe components, user, and person CRUD operations, following MVC, DAO, and DTO
design patterns

Wrote unit tests for service using NUnitFramework and NSubstitute libraries

Designed schema and implemented a core recipe data MySQL Database, and used MongoDB
for recipe text sections

Created both a JavaScript /Bootstrap, and a single-page Angular5/ AngularMaterial2 front
end

positions.title: Volunteer Consultant on Native-Seed Tracker Application
positions.description:
Helped architect and design a web application for the tracking and managing of native-seed
collection and distribution for the Center for Natural Lands Management under the direction of the Conservation Nursery Program Manager

Consulted on front-end, user experience, and process flow inquiries, created sample pages,
coached employees in front-end design and scoped and created project timeline

positions.title: System Analyst
positions.description:
Performed project planning, analysis, and management on portfolio of content management
and distribution applications


CUSTOMER PROFILE SYSTEM
Saved the company approximately $500k by delivering a homegrown replacement application
for a legacy 3rd party system before contract renewal date

Served as application lead, performing all analysis, project management, front-end design, and testing activities from project initiation to delivery

Lead development team in stand-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives, and produced weekly in-depth status reports

Determined and defined all API requirements with developers, and condensed three existing
data models into a simplified and comprehensible XML format

Designed application flow and UI, with sitemap, wireframes, and a product style guide

Conducted problem, data, and process decomposition analysis and delivered a product
roadmap, project scope, and plan


CROSS-SYSTEM ORDER AND DELIVERY REPORTING
Delivered a unified reporting system for orders and deliveries giving managers and
representatives insight into delivery fulfillment speeds and timelines

Co-designed intuitive and business-oriented semantic layer, dashboard widgets, calculation
logic, and assessed viability of open-source data-visualization tool

Served as project lead from analysis to delivery and spearheaded user participation in design
process, requirements validation, and UAT


DECOMMISSION ASSESSMENTS ON LEGACY PRODUCTS
Reduced the company overhead for licensing maintenance and support fees by delivering use
case and functionality assessment of existing systems, and providing recommendations for
alternative delivery systems of system capabilities

WB.COM DATA FEED
Performed data analysis on the completeness and validity of data stored across 11 territories
to assess viability of data feed, managed estimates on this multi-system service

MISC
Helped prepare, design, and conduct STEAM event for local students
positions.insights: Skills: Systems Analysis · Strategic Roadmaps · SDLC · Technology Roadmapping · Agile Methodologies · Cloud Computing

company.name: Warner Bros. Entertainment Group of Companies

positions.title: Business Analyst
positions.description:
Served as Lead Analyst on UX/UI design of flagship product, eliciting and verifying
requirements, conducting problem analysis, and designing solutions through business process
re-engineering, data analysis, and usability testing

Partnered with development team for Technical Reviews, Implementation, QA, and UAT and
authored in-depth product requirement documents, wireframes, use cases, and process flow,
data flow, and system context diagrams

Established a beta group and initiated user testing as part of the company SDLC and
conducted feature presentations to business stakeholders

Designed and managed several projects to completion including: a redesign of all transaction
screens; implementation of a job advertisement recruiting feature; an update to the system’s
email management component and message templates; an improved rich text commenting
system, and a Product Forum to facilitate communication between training and product team

Developed design for medical and corporate compliance modules, search redesign, and
entity relationship modification

positions.title: Technical Writer
positions.description:
Designed and coded Release Note and Recruiting Strategies Websites

Initiated, planned, and executed persona, and business area mapping projects

Developed company Style Guide, Product Requirements Document, Short PRD, Business
Process Analysis worksheet, Release Notes, and Requirement Categorization templates and
produced regular help documentation, Release Notes, and Field Visit Reports with User
Interviews and conducted Product Training and Release Webinars

positions.title: Technical Writer
positions.description:
Designed and created User Manuals, Quick Start Guides, Knowledge Base articles, Release Notes, Flow Charts, and Beta Preview packets

Coordinated with Development, Product Managers, Marketing, and Support to provide accurate, professional, and user-friendly material 

Reformatted the 2011-2012 Paymaster book (a compendium of the entertainment industry’s union rates, terms, and conditions)

Designed and coded internal website for online help, to replace a document file store and
printed documentation

Helped coordinate and conduct Usability Testing and designed internal Certification Courses for new products

positions.title: Market Research Analyst
positions.description:
Submitted proposal with a range of options for the history’s approach and marketing message 

Researched company history; designed and conducted 30 interviews with employees, executives, and customers; and produced written transcripts of interviews

Synthesized information into a cohesive and entertaining book-length narrative

positions.title: Sales Operations Representative Coordinator
positions.description:
Synchronized, compiled, and updated critical information from multiple databases

Provided research and support in solving order related issues for both customers and employees

Composed and edited procedure manuals and trained incoming and current employees

positions.title: Business Analyst
positions.description:
Served as Lead Analyst on UX/UI design of flagship product, eliciting and verifying
requirements, conducting problem analysis, and designing solutions through business process
re-engineering, data analysis, and usability testing

Partnered with development team for Technical Reviews, Implementation, QA, and UAT and
authored in-depth product requirement documents, wireframes, use cases, and process flow,

conducted feature presentations to business stakeholders

screens; implementation of a job advertisement recruiting feature; an update to the system’s
email management component and message templates; an improved rich text commenting
system, and a Product Forum to facilitate communication between training and product team

Developed design for medical and corporate compliance modules, search redesign, and
entity relationship modification
